preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 200000 for n in ns_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 2 and 2*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 1000000 for x in a) for a in altitudes_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the altitudes are integers between 1 and 10^6.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == max_edges(altitudes_list[i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output line is the maximum number of edges possible for the corresponding test case, where max_edges(a) is computed as follows: sort a to get s; let m be the count of elements equal to s[0] (min value) and k be the count of elements equal to s[-1] (max value); if m == n (all equal), result is n*(n-1)//2; else if m == 1 or k == 1, result is n*(n-1)//2 - 1; else result is n*(n-1)//2 - m - k + 1.
